title: 500 dollarga sotilgan patent qaysi o'yinni tug'di...
hook: 1904 yilda bir ayol o'yin uchun patent oldi.

scenes.text: 1904 yilda amerikalik Lizzi Magi o'zi o'ylab topgan stol o'yini uchun patent oldi.
O'yin nomi "Uy egasi o'yini" edi. Maqsadi yer monopoliyasining zararini ko'rsatish edi.
O'yin qo'lma-qo'l tarqaldi. 1935 yilda Charlz Darrou uning bir variantini Parker Brothers kompaniyasiga sotdi.
Shundan keyin Parker Brothers Magining patentini atigi 500 dollarga sotib oldi.
Darrou o'yindan katta boylik ortirdi. Magining nomi esa o'nlab yillar unutildi. O'yinning nomi Monopoliya edi.

description:
Lizzi Magi 1904 yilda "The Landlord's Game" o'yini uchun patent olgan. 1935 yilda Charlz Darrou uning bir variantini Monopoliya nomi bilan Parker Brothers'ga sotgan, kompaniya esa Magining patentini 500 dollarga sotib olgan.

Siz Monopoliya o'ynaganmisiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; the pages themselves did not open). TRUE: patent 1904 (US 748,626), Parker Brothers bought Magie's patent for $500 in 1935, aim of the game to show harm of land monopoly. SOFTENED: 'Darrou millioner bo'ldi' changed to 'katta boylik ortirdi' (only a secondary source calls Darrow the first game inventor millionaire; some sources date Magie's sale slightly differently). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lizzie_Magie ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Landlord%27s_Game ; https://www.bl.uk/stories/blogs/posts/lizzie-magie-and-the-history-of-monopoly ; https://www.history.com/news/monopoly-game-inventor-elizabeth-magie ; https://www.womenshistory.org/articles/monopolys-lost-female-inventor ; https://www.smithsonianmag.com/arts-culture/monopoly-was-designed-teach99-about-income-inequality-180953630/
